adapterAdvice.productionInputs: Original local assets only; archived generated JS not used as executable application.
adapterAdvice.closure: Inline root <use> needs referenced original symbol definitions. Map every svg_dependencies entry by id to exact archived definition; recursively close refs and rewrite IDs per instance or shared sprite namespace. Do not use root <use> as standalone img without closure.
adapterAdvice.cssMaskSvg: 10 hero logo archive files contain CSS-escaped quotes; decode these exact CSS strings before XML parse. Preserve primitives/viewBox and mask sizing; white background paints their silhouette. Do not alter archive bytes.
adapterAdvice.cssVariables: Original fills use var(--token...) fallbacks; wrapper style variables must be inherited in inline SVG or replaced in a build adapter with source fallback values. External img cannot inherit document vars.
adapterAdvice.foreignObject: The hero wordmark file is SVG foreignObject text requiring CalSans in the page; using it as external img risks font fallback. Implement equivalent original text and scaling in component.
adapterAdvice.currentAdapter: Integrator now produces public/assets/resolved-svg/<manifestAssetId>.svg and src/assets/catalog.json. Mapped resolvedUrl values verified present. Original archive remains unchanged.
